summary: The reimagining of Dark Yugi's Duelist Kingdom deck: Black Luster Soldier and Magician of Black Chaos return as a dual-purpose Ritual series. One Ritual Spell summons either boss monster and keeps recurring itself, while Mind Shuffle loops resources between the two. Grindy control/midrange with the most developed combo lines of any new CORI archetype so far.
sourceNote: Card text below was updated 2026-07-08 via live web search (WebFetch to Yugipedia, YGOPRODeck, and Konami's own official database all returned HTTP 403 — blocked before any page content could be retrieved, so none of this was cross-checked against a primary source directly). Search results for these very-new (6-day-old) cards were inconsistent across queries: one pass reported Skull Archfiend of Chaos at ATK 2500/DEF 1200, a follow-up pass couldn't reproduce that and admitted it may have been conflating an older, unrelated 'Skull Archfiend' series card — so its ATK/DEF here were deliberately left at this file's prior values rather than overwritten with an unverified number. Magician of Dark Chaos – Black Chaos's effect changed materially from the prior draft (no shuffle-into-Deck alt-summon found; instead a GY Spell recovery + on-summon banish effect), and Black Luster Soldier gained a previously-missing on-Special-Summon banish effect. Treat every effectText field here as best-effort and paraphrased (not verbatim Konami wording) rather than confirmed — verify against Konami's official card database before finalizing a tournament deck list.

cards.name: Ritual of Light and Darkness
cards.effectText: Ritual Summons “Magician of Dark Chaos – Black Chaos” or “Black Luster Soldier – Soldier of Light and Darkness” by tributing monsters and/or banishing from your GY to meet the Ritual Summon's Level requirement. Once per turn, add this card plus 1 other card that mentions “Light and Darkness Ritual” from your GY to your hand.

cards.name: Black Luster Soldier – Soldier of Light and Darkness
cards.effectText: Must first be Ritual Summoned. Cannot be destroyed by battle. Unaffected by your opponent's activated effects unless they target this card. Once per turn each: if this card is Special Summoned, you can target 1 card your opponent controls and banish it; if this card destroys a monster by battle, it gains 1500 ATK and can make a second attack in the same Battle Phase.

cards.name: Magician of Dark Chaos – Black Chaos
cards.effectText: Must first be Ritual Summoned. Unaffected by your opponent's activated effects unless they target this card. Your Spells/Traps cannot be destroyed or banished by your opponent's card effects. Once per turn each: if this card is Special Summoned, you can add 1 Spell from your GY to your hand; you can also target 1 card your opponent controls and banish it face-down.

cards.name: Skull Archfiend of Chaos
cards.effectText: If this card is in your hand or GY: you can place 3 other cards from either GY and/or face-up banishment on the bottom of the Deck in any order — at least 1 must mention “Light and Darkness Ritual” — to Special Summon this card. If this card is sent to the GY: send a Ritual Spell from your hand or Deck to the GY, then add the Ritual Monster it mentions from your Deck to your hand. Each effect once per turn.

cards.name: Mind Shuffle
cards.effectText: Add 1 monster that mentions “Light and Darkness Ritual” from your Deck to your hand, then discard 1 card. Once per turn. Alternatively, when your opponent activates a card or effect, you can return 1 Level 7 or higher monster you control to the hand and Special Summon a differently-named “Light and Darkness Ritual” monster from your hand, ignoring its Summoning conditions.

cards.name: Griffoh
cards.effectText: (Quick Effect) Discard this card, then either: reduce the next battle or effect damage you'd take this turn to 0; or Set 1 Quick-Play Spell/Trap that mentions “Light and Darkness Ritual” from your Deck and treat it as able to be activated this turn (this is how it lets Mind Shuffle — a Quick-Play Spell — be used the same turn it hits the field). Once per turn. Can also be used as the entire Tribute cost for Ritually Summoning exactly 1 Level 8 Ritual Monster whose effect requires tributing monsters. Attribute/Type/Level/ATK/DEF still unconfirmed.

comboLines.title: Mind Shuffle grind loop
comboLines.body: Send Skull Archfiend of Chaos to the GY to send Ritual of Light and Darkness to the GY and tutor a Ritual Monster, then use Mind Shuffle to recur pieces and Ritual Summon. Set Griffoh to enable Mind Shuffle the same turn. Swap between Black Luster Soldier – Soldier of Light and Darkness (offense, battle-destruction snowball, plus an on-Special-Summon banish) and Magician of Dark Chaos – Black Chaos (protection/banish, plus GY Spell recovery on Special Summon) depending on board state. Documented in early web coverage as the deck's core engine; see sourceNote — treat exact wording as best-effort, not confirmed.

sampleDecklist.label: Community-documented list with a real combo engine (Mind Shuffle loop) — more developed than most other new CORI archetypes, but still not a tournament Top Cut list.
